_comment_overrides: ONLY these keys may differ from the training config. Everything that
defines an episode -- variant, max_steps, command_timeout, generate_config,
the judge, the reward, the concurrency caps, the vector geometry -- is
inherited from es/run_config.json and is checked for equality at startup
which is the two conditions; episodes_per_candidate=64 is the epochs of the
single inspect batch, so the batch is 2 x 64 = 128 episodes.
candidate_id_base=9100 keeps the eval's served ids (9101, 9102) distinct
from every training id (9001..9016) so no log can be confused for the other
run. state_dir/history_path are moved out of es/state on purpose: the
evaluator never writes a checkpoint, and pointing them anywhere near the
trainer's state would be the one way this script could damage the run.

overrides.notes: held-out final evaluation: trained theta vs strength-0 control, one batch, one vLLM restart
